evidence_status: Public-source dimensional anchors, inferred core and services, and photo-informed architectural detail. Not an as-built, structural design, coordinated construction or engineering approval model.

lifts.evidence: R02 states 16 office passenger lifts; R03 plans suggest three bank sectors; R04 shows transfers at 21/22. Exact bank allocation/stops and two upper shuttle proxies are assumptions. R06 historic total 18 remains an unresolved scope conflict. Architectural v3 ends transfer shuttles at model L39 and adds a separate small bar-access lift proxy from R12/R13 observations; this does not resolve the historical passenger-lift count conflict.

exclusions: No survey, coordinated construction drawings, exact core dimensions or current tenant fit-out are available; plan-derived locations are approximate.
The original demo remains unchanged. This preset combines dated public sources, not one verified historical or current state.
Lift bank allocation, travel limits and two upper shuttle proxies are inferred; 16-office-lift and 18-passenger-lift public totals have unresolved scope differences.
Model level indices and exceptional lobby/top floor heights are approximate; published transfer-level labels are stored as evidence, not surveyed stop coordinates.
No structural loads, member design, connections, foundations or lateral analysis; radial beam and column sections are proxies.
No fire strategy, egress-capacity, sprinkler coverage/hydraulics, accessibility or code-compliance assessment.
Wet risers and basin branches are conceptual. Drainage branches, pressure zoning, insulation, valves and rated penetrations are not designed.
Four-pipe fan coils are equipment proxies with labelled connection stubs; complete HVAC ductwork and hydronic distribution are not designed.
Electrical routes are geometric networks only: voltage, conductor ratings, loads, protection, fault levels, earthing, selectivity, emergency supply and lux are unverified.
DALI link/address groups are illustrative; device commissioning and protocol capacity/compliance are not verified.
Pipe-system clearance, protected-shaft routing and terminal connectivity checks are limited checks, not an exhaustive clash or engineering coordination review.

Basement, accommodation stairs at published levels 19-25, separate cafe pavilion, retail tenancy, surveyed entrance coordinates, accessible door strategy and exact restaurant/kitchen layout remain omitted.

Facade triangles and mullions are a computational subdivision, not a reproduction of the 5,500 installed triangular and diamond panels. Double-skin glazing, blinds, drainage and operable vents are not fabricated assemblies.
The entrance uses four revolving-door proxies, photo-informed chevrons and a 7 m lobby panel height. Door setting-out, accessibility, operation, fixing and weather seals are unverified.
Triangular crown members reproduce the published gross section envelope; internal plate thickness and welded joints are unknown. The apex lens is a faceted geometric approximation.
Added furniture, interior glass, planting and plaza detail are illustrative. Public plans and supplied cutaway imagery do not establish current tenant furnishings.
Architectural captures temporarily hide MEP and cut native meshes. The complete saved model retains electrical and service geometry.

Upper amenity topology follows dated operator diagrams: open Iris mezzanine, circular stair and five private dining rooms. All setting-out, capacities, fire separation, main-stair termination and small bar-lift details remain inferred; the public plans are not construction drawings.

structure.evidence: R01 supports steel core, radial beams on 10-degree centres and perimeter hoops. Core bearing radius, member sections/positions, dome lattice sampling and omitted collisions are inferred.

electrical.evidence: R04 dual power supply; R05 DALI, LON/BMS integration and occupancy/daylight multisensors. All board positions, feed assignment, outlets, circuit grouping, cable/tray dimensions and routes are inferred. No electrical ratings are selected.

architecture.target: Original completed-building appearance and furnished cutaway inspired by user references; tenant layout and site coordinates remain inferred.

crown.evidence: R01: 30 m diameter, 22 m rise, fabricated triangular 110 x 150 mm sections. R06: 2.4 m apex lens. Ring elevations, member count, gross solid section, lens profile and surround are inferred; connections and plate thickness are not designed. The squared-radius cap uses (1-t)(1+0.25t); its taper is inferred from imagery, not measured.

diagrid.evidence: R01: 508 x 40 mm ground-L2, 273 x 12.5 mm L36-38 CHS. Intermediate sizes interpolate; joint geometry and loading are unverified.

entrance.evidence: R11 supplier states four Crystal Tourniket revolving doors. R10 states 7 m aluminium lobby panels. U03 shows recessed entry and white chevrons. Locations, sizes except panel height, door leaves and canopy are inferred; front is model -Y, not a surveyed compass bearing.

presentation.evidence: U04 is a visual presentation and furnishing reference, not dimensional evidence.

private_dining.evidence: Five rooms supported by R12; rectangular footprints, dimensions, orientation and inward door setting-out inferred to clear the shuttle shafts.

upper_amenity.evidence: R12 operator plan shows an open, approximately D-shaped Iris mezzanine and circular stair, Helix lift lobby and five private dining rooms on L38. R13 first-hand access observations report a small lift to the bar. Scale, orientation, dimensions, riser count, central lift position, main stair termination at L39 and service penetrations are inferred; no egress or accessibility design.
